clauses.text: In Colombia, every vehicle on a public road must carry the SOAT. The civil liability insurance of this policy is voluntary and adds to the SOAT. Autos Poblado does not issue it with limits below these minimums: COP 25,000,000 for the death or injury of one person, COP 50,000,000 for all victims of one accident and COP 20,000,000 for third-party property damage.

An insurer that decides to revoke a policy must notify the policyholder in writing at least ten days in advance and refund the unearned premium (Commercial Code, art. 1071). If the premium is not paid, the contract ends automatically (Commercial Code, art. 1068).

Anyone who suffers a loss event must report it to their insurer within three business days of learning about it. The parties may extend that period but not shorten it (Commercial Code, arts. 1075 and 829).
Drivers must have a current SOAT, which traffic authorities check in the national registry. The law does not require the voluntary insurance of this policy to drive.

Actions arising from the insurance contract expire two years after the interested party learned, or should have learned, of the event that gives rise to them, and in any case five years after the right arises (Commercial Code, art. 1081).
